The Challenge

Most Enterprise AI Stays in Pilot Mode

Organisations know Claude is powerful. What they lack is the architecture, governance, and institutional knowledge to move from demo to production at scale.

⚠ The Problem

Proof-of-concepts don't become production systems on their own

Internal teams explore Claude through prompts and one-off experiments. But without agentic architecture, MCP integration, proper governance frameworks, and enterprise deployment patterns, the value stays locked in sandboxes — impressive demos that never reach the people who need them most.

◈ Our Solution

Production-grade Claude systems, built by practitioners

Fynaptix designs and builds the complete Claude AI layer your organisation will run on — from agentic workflows and RAG systems to CoWork deployment and AI governance frameworks. Every engagement delivers working infrastructure, not slide decks.

The Process

How Fynaptix Works

A structured three-stage methodology that takes you from AI readiness to production deployment — with governance built in from the start.

01

Assessment & Strategy

We audit your current AI maturity, identify high-value Claude use cases, and produce a prioritised build roadmap — including a build-vs-buy recommendation matrix and compliance alignment against your industry's requirements.

Discovery Engagement
02

Architecture & Build

We design and build your Claude AI layer — agentic workflows, RAG systems, MCP integrations, CoWork deployment, and custom tooling — using patterns proven in production enterprise environments.

Production Build
03

Operationalise & Enable

We stand up the observability, governance, and enablement layer that keeps your Claude systems reliable and your teams productive long after the build is complete.

AIOps & Training
What We Build

Fynaptix Services

Three practice areas. Seventeen services. Everything your organisation needs to design, build, and operationalise production Claude AI.

Category 1

Claude AI Architecture & Development

⚡

AI Strategy & Readiness Assessment

A structured discovery engagement that audits your current AI maturity, identifies high-value use cases, and produces a prioritised roadmap — with a build-vs-buy recommendation matrix and compliance alignment against your industry's regulatory requirements.

◎

Agentic Workflow Design & Implementation

Design and build production-grade agentic systems that handle document processing, customer onboarding, approval workflows, research pipelines, and more — with orchestration architecture, failure handling, and cost controls built for reliability at enterprise scale.

◈

Claude API Integration & Production Deployment

Full-stack integration of the Claude API into your existing systems — covering model selection, prompt versioning, streaming, cost optimisation, and deployment patterns on AWS Bedrock, Azure, or GCP. Built for production, not demos.

◉

RAG Architecture & Enterprise Knowledge Systems

Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions that ground Claude in your internal knowledge — policy libraries, product documentation, compliance frameworks, or proprietary data — with vector database selection, chunking strategy, and retrieval evaluation.

⚡

Multi-Agent Orchestration Architecture

Architect systems where multiple Claude agents collaborate — one researches, one drafts, one reviews, one routes — handling tasks of genuine complexity, with independent review instance design, multi-pass analysis patterns, and observability for production oversight.

◈

MCP Server Development & Integration

Build custom Model Context Protocol servers that give Claude read/write access to your CRMs, ERPs, ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira), internal databases, and proprietary APIs — production-grade, reusable connectors built on the emerging universal standard for AI-to-tool connectivity.

◎

Prompt Engineering & Structured Output Design

Systematic prompt library development covering structured JSON outputs, classification pipelines, document extraction, and summarisation workflows — with evaluation frameworks and regression testing so your outputs remain reliable across model updates.

Category 2

Claude CoWork Enterprise Deployment

◉

CoWork Enterprise Rollout & Governance Setup

End-to-end deployment of Claude CoWork at enterprise scale — including role-based access controls, group spend limits, per-tool connector controls, and usage analytics configuration. Takes the governance burden off your IT team so knowledge workers can start on day one.

⚡

SSO & Identity Provider Integration

Configure Single Sign-On through Okta, Azure Active Directory, Google Workspace, or SAML 2.0, and implement SCIM for automatic user provisioning and deprovisioning — so access is managed automatically through your existing identity infrastructure.

◈

Private Plugin Marketplace Development

Design and build a private CoWork plugin marketplace tailored to your business units. Plugins bundle tools, institutional knowledge, and workflow logic into a single install — so every team gets a Claude that already knows how they work.

◎

Connector Configuration & Systems Integration

Map and configure CoWork connectors to the platforms your teams already use — Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, DocuSign, Salesforce, FactSet, and more — with the right permissions and access controls for each department.

◉

Scheduled Task Automation Design

Design and configure scheduled CoWork automations — weekly report generation, email triage, metrics pulls, Slack digests, document summaries — defined once and handled by Claude on a recurring cadence, freeing your knowledge workers to focus on the work that actually matters.

⚡

Inference Gateway & Data Sovereignty Architecture

For enterprises in regulated industries or with data sovereignty requirements, architect a self-hosted inference gateway so CoWork routes every request through infrastructure you control — compatible with Amazon Bedrock and any Messages API-compatible endpoint.

◈

CoWork Adoption & Change Management

Design the onboarding experience that turns CoWork from a tool people signed up for into one they can't work without — including team-specific welcome artifacts, example prompt libraries, department-level training, and a 90-day adoption programme with usage analytics milestones.

Category 3

AI Governance, Safety & Enablement

◉

AI Safety & Responsible Deployment

Covers Constitutional AI principles, safe system prompt design, refusal handling, red-teaming, and deployment patterns for regulated industries — finance, healthcare, legal, and government. Produces governance documentation suitable for auditors and risk committees.

⚡

AI Operations (AIOps) & Monitoring Frameworks

Build the observability layer around your Claude deployments — OpenTelemetry integration, logging pipelines, output quality scoring, anomaly detection, and executive cost dashboards. Claude in production needs ongoing reliability assurance, not just initial deployment.

◈

Internal AI Enablement & Training

Structured training programmes for every level — from non-technical staff getting productive with Claude faster, to developer teams mastering API patterns, MCP integration, and agentic design. Delivered as workshops, cohort programmes, or on-demand resources built for your organisation.

◎

Proof-of-Concept & Pilot Programmes

Time-boxed 4–8 week engagements that turn a specific enterprise use case into a working, documented prototype — with architecture decisions, cost projections, and a scaling roadmap. The lowest-risk entry point to meaningful AI adoption, and the fastest path to internal executive buy-in.
